data.body: c465 (PydanticAIRunner lifecycle revalidation) research in progress: mapped full effect/resource timeline of run(); confirmed via monkeypatch-target census (~25+ sites across agent_call/structured_run/providers/model_classes/runner_support seams) that ADR 0056/0058 extraction already owns every helper concern. Found existing resource-lifecycle fault-matrix coverage (test_provider_session_guard.py, test_llm_fallback_chain.py) from prior tickets (a49e/ADR 0056 decision 2/4). Discovered ONE genuine uncharacterized gap: finalize_outcome (runner.py:725) runs OUTSIDE both the ProviderSession with-block and the failure-accounting try/except, so a raise there logs via log_call_success (by design) but skips record_call_spend (no spend row) and skips interpret_failure/step_failures accounting entirely -- mirrors but is not fixed by bug 8455. Added characterization test test_a_raise_in_finalize_outcome_still_logs_but_skips_the_spend_row (tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py), proven RED via source mutation then restored GREEN (mutation-teeth check passed, no sandbox needed -- no filesystem-deletion code involved). Confirmed complexity baseline: run()=23, _memo_toolsets=16, both already baselined (new=0 increased=0) -- run()'s complexity is inherent orchestration glue, not a fixable defect. All 6 files in scope within the 800 LOC cap with headroom. Plan-review (rebar review-plan) still running in background (/tmp/review_c465.log, pid 27321) -- not yet claimed. Leaning conclusion: no restructuring warranted; existing ADR 0056/0058 decomposition already satisfies this ticket's constraints; will file a follow-up ticket for the finalize-outcome spend-row gap rather than fixing it in this research ticket's scope.
